protocol_changes: each principal-tick is one opportunity and route start is a Bernoulli draw at the frozen probability
paired conditions use identical opportunity draws
audit separates queued-unstarted from started-in-service unfinished tasks
each negative control is compared with frozen adoption at its exact effective verifier topology/capacity

model.matched_randomness: opportunity and task-start uniform draws are keyed by topology, seed, principal and tick and reused across conditions; adoption draws use a separate stream
model.p95: nearest-rank over all completed-task latencies; unfinished tasks remain separately counted and are never censored into completions

decision.primary: peer/shared_1 p95 exceeds reduced_frozen/shared_1 for the same topology/seed/imitation, while task interaction cost is 6 versus 10
decision.pass: for both imitation values and both topologies, at least 3/4 paired seeds have a primary reversal; no-imitation/shared_1 vs reduced_frozen/shared_1, peer/shared_24 vs reduced_frozen/shared_24, and peer/per_principal vs reduced_frozen/per_principal have zero reversals
decision.otherwise: NO_REVERSAL_IN_GRID if no primary cell reverses; otherwise METHOD_FAIL_OR_INCONCLUSIVE
decision.scope: finite synthetic mechanism analysis only; no human, runtime, empirical adoption elasticity, operational queue, or safety claim
